issue: GEM lists Owner=AGP City Gas Pvt Ltd / Parent=I Squared Capital. As of latest reporting the AG&P (Nebula/AG&P) acquisition of H-Energy's Jaigarh terminal is still in NEGOTIATION, not closed; and Hoegh LNG TERMINATED the Hoegh Giant FSRU charter (effective April) citing charterer default, with H-Energy accepting the FSRU contract is at an end. The terminal therefore currently has no committed FSRU.
suggested_action: Do NOT change owner (deal not closed). Re-verify owner/operator and FSRU-vessel status next batch; current GEM owner may predate or conflate the unfinished AG&P deal. Source: LNG Prime https://lngprime.com/contracts-and-tenders/hoegh-lng-terminates-fsru-charter-with-indias-h-energy/52649/

issue: Jafrabad (Swan LNG) Phase 1 remains in construction: 92.3% physical progress as of 31 Dec 2025 per Gujarat Legislative Assembly, deadline Sept 2026. In Dec 2024 Swan Energy + AG&P signed a HOA for a JV to provide the FSRU and an FSU (AG&P 51% / SEL 49% of the vessel). GEM owner/parent (Swan/IFFCO/GMB/GSPL/Mitsui) describes the terminal SPV equity, which is distinct from the AG&P vessel-provision JV.
suggested_action: Status=construction confirmed (no edit). When fetch_timeline is up, confirm ConstructionYear and any revised start (Sept 2026 target). Keep vessel-provider AG&P JV out of terminal equity fields. Source: DeshGujarat https://deshgujarat.com/2026/02/25/jafrabad-lng-fsru-project-92-3-complete-deadline-sept-2026-gujarat-govt/
